hero.headline: Help Your SMB Customers Start Selling Online — Under Your Brand
hero.description: SMBs face growing pressure to sell online, but most lack the skills, budget, or time to manage a full ecommerce stack. Hostopia's white-label Online Store is a turnkey, mobile-ready ecommerce platform you resell under your brand — integrated with Online Presence Builder so SMBs add a store with one click and scale as they grow.

items.title: Launch a real store fast — without a consultant
items.body: Most SMB ecommerce projects stall on the setup alone: tax rules, shipping rates, payment gateways, and product imports overwhelm owners before they sell a single item. Hostopia's guided 5-step setup wizard walks customers through products, taxes, shipping, and payment configuration in one session — with sensible defaults that actually work. Owners finish setup in an afternoon instead of giving up after a weekend, which means more stores go live, more products get listed, and more customers start transacting on your platform.

image.alt: Quick online store setup and checkout

items.title: Sell everywhere their customers already are
items.body: Modern commerce isn't one storefront — it's a dozen. Hostopia's Online Store publishes products to the SMB's website, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon, and Google Shopping from a single dashboard, with centralized inventory and order management keeping everything synchronized. Owners never manually copy a product to three platforms again, and customers browse wherever they discover the brand. For you, that breadth differentiates your ecommerce offering from single-channel builders and justifies premium pricing.

items.title: Accept any payment, in any currency, on any device
items.body: Payment friction kills checkouts. Hostopia supports 40+ gateways including PayPal, Square, Stripe, and regional processors, plus multi-currency support and real-time shipping quotes from major carriers. Customers check out on desktop, tablet, or smartphone with a responsive experience optimized for the device they're on — which is overwhelmingly mobile. Fewer abandoned carts, higher conversion, and no "can I pay another way?" emails for your support team to handle.

items.title: Keep every dollar of margin with zero transaction fees
items.body: Transaction fees from some platforms quietly eat 1–2% of every sale — a massive tax on SMBs already operating on thin margins. Hostopia's Online Store charges zero transaction fees, so owners keep the full margin on every sale after payment processor costs. That's real money back in the business each month, and it's one of the easiest differentiators for your sales team to articulate against competing platforms during deal conversations.

image.alt: Revenue growth and healthy business margins

items.title: Grow without replatforming as the store scales
items.body: Most SMBs abandon their first store when traffic or product count outgrows the platform — and the migration to a bigger system is where they churn. Hostopia's tiered plans, multi-channel architecture, and enterprise-grade infrastructure support stores from their first 10 products to their first 10,000 — on the same platform, under the same brand, with no re-migration required. Customers stay with you through their entire growth curve, and you capture the upsell revenue instead of losing it to a new provider.

image.alt: Ecommerce scaling and growth on one platform

features.heading: Full-Featured Ecommerce — Without the Complexity
features.intro: Online Store gives SMBs everything they need to sell online, integrated into the website they already have with you — and scalable across every revenue channel as they grow.

cards.title: Mobile-Ready Commerce

cards.title: Multi-Channel Selling
cards.body: Sell on the website plus Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon, and Google Shopping — with centralized inventory and unified order management.

cards.title: 40+ Payment Gateways
cards.body: PayPal, Square, Stripe, and regional gateways, with multi-currency support and real-time shipping quotes. Customers check out however they prefer to pay.

cards.title: Revenue-Driving Tools

cards.title: Zero Transaction Fees
cards.body: SMBs keep the full margin on every sale. Hostopia charges no platform transaction fees — a clean differentiator your sales team can own in every ecommerce conversation.

partnerAdvantage.heading: Turn Websites into Revenue Engines
partnerAdvantage.intro: Online Store transforms your website customers into ecommerce customers — with higher ARPU, stronger retention, and natural upsell into payment, security, and marketing services.

items.title: Expand ARPU from existing customers
items.body: Every website customer is a potential store customer. Tiered ecommerce plans let SMBs upgrade as they add products, traffic, and revenue channels — compounding spend on your platform.

items.title: Bundle into a complete digital stack
items.body: Online Store pairs with websites, SSL, domains, and marketing tools to create high-value packages that are harder to replace and easier to retain.

items.title: Offer DIY and managed models
items.body: Self-serve setup for tech-comfortable SMBs, or managed DIFM service for higher-touch clients. Same platform, two revenue models, broader addressable market.

items.title: Differentiate on fees and reach
items.body: Zero transaction fees plus multi-channel selling give your sales team clean, quantifiable differentiators against every major competitor in the ecommerce category.
